command:
import hashlib,pathlib,subprocess,tarfile,json
p=pathlib.Path('/work/panel.tgz')
subprocess.run(['curl','-L','--fail','--silent','--show-error','--retry','2','--max-time','600','-o',str(p),'https://github.com/isogeny-labs/crypto-autoresearcher/releases/download/semaev-closure-certificates-20261029/semaev-panel-worker-20261029.tar.gz'],check=True)
def sha(p):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with p.open('rb') as f:
  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''): h.update(b)
 return h.hexdigest()
assert sha(p)=='d102a62d39f6b9790789f1f3570cb06f4b7e2122e022c0cad8ef25b356b990ff'
dest=pathlib.Path('/work/panel');dest.mkdir()
with tarfile.open(p) as t:
 for m in t.getmembers():
  q=pathlib.PurePosixPath(m.name)
  assert not q.is_absolute() and '..' not in q.parts and m.isfile()
 t.extractall(dest)
manifest=json.loads((dest/'panel-manifest.json').read_text())
for n,h in manifest['files'].items(): assert sha(dest/n)==h,n
print('Frozen protocol e2dba202709c7eb047a0546071cc5fd72e091e73efa274452eeddab2c5291850; all bundle hashes verified',flush=True)
driver=pathlib.Path('/work/run_panel_worker_v2.py')
subprocess.run(['curl','-L','--fail','--silent','--show-error','--retry','2','--max-time','60','-o',str(driver),'https://github.com/isogeny-labs/crypto-autoresearcher/releases/download/semaev-closure-certificates-20261029/run_panel_worker_v2.py?verify=1605'],check=True)
assert sha(driver)=='2ac2be4207e170c661dd7ff0ae306a1c50abdaf43a5f1bf827a0edf609be6983'
portable_archive=pathlib.Path('/work/portable.tgz')
subprocess.run(['curl','-L','--fail','--silent','--show-error','--retry','2','--max-time','60','-o',str(portable_archive),'https://github.com/isogeny-labs/crypto-autoresearcher/releases/download/semaev-closure-certificates-20261029/semaev-worker-portable-20261029.tar.gz'],check=True)
assert sha(portable_archive)=='659c1fb30fd448a3ab8d4dec5fe6d8d70b9409de07a1f3dee84ee99bfb05709e'
portable=pathlib.Path('/work/portable');portable.mkdir()
with tarfile.open(portable_archive) as t:
 for m in t.getmembers():
  q=pathlib.PurePosixPath(m.name)
  assert not q.is_absolute() and '..' not in q.parts and m.isfile()
 t.extractall(portable)
subprocess.run(['python3',str(driver),'--bundle',str(portable),'--request',str(dest/'requests/fresh-n44-poly-01/request.json'),'--out','/work/results/panel','--upload'],check=True)
